lines.say: One study looked at the top selling pre-workouts.
The average scoop had about two hundred fifty milligrams of caffeine. That's like two or three coffees.
Caffeine is usually doing most of the work.
Many hide their doses inside a proprietary blend, so you can't see how much of each ingredient you get.
And supplements aren't checked for safety before they're sold. Banned stimulants have turned up in some.
Pick products tested by a third party, and count the caffeine. Under eighteen, pregnant, or have heart issues? Skip it.
Next: electrolytes. Do you need them?
